records.sourceEdition: Run Nov. 1; polls retrieved Nov. 1; retrieved Nov. 1 13:35 UTC
records.note: The Nov. 1 run retains 99% Democratic House control, raises the House median from 250 to 251 Democratic seats, and raises the exact 51-or-more Democratic Senate outcome from 70.1% to 70.5%. The Senate headline remains rounded to 70%; expected seats remain 52 Democrats, 47 Republicans and one independent. Republican control remains a distinct 24.2% total (16.2% for 51+ seats plus 8.0% for exactly 50 with the Republican vice president), and independent balance remains 5.3%.

The Oct. 31 class-model snapshot retains 95% Democratic House control, 43% Democratic Senate control, 237 Democratic House seats and 50 Democratic Senate seats. A 50-seat Senate result resolves Republican under the source's stated rule.
